plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Photography Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 12, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7582/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each course). Official Total Units: 17-19; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end = 3+8+6 = 17 units (PHOTO 280 at 2 units). Semester sums verified against the map's 3 / 8-10 / 6 headers. Choice slots: (1) ME PHOTO 210 / PHOTO 212 — Photography Business (prerequisite: PHOTO 302 & PHOTO 312 with grades of C or better; or equivalent/technical competency determined by a photography department faculty member upon evaluation of photography portfolio); (2-3) two Major Elective slots (3 units each) — a minimum of 6 units (3 units per semester, not repeating) from PHOTO 266, PHOTO 267, PHOTO 268, PHOTO 269, PHOTO 281, PHOTO 341, PHOTO 350/JOUR 360, PHOTO 380, PHOTO 393, PHOTO 400, PHOTO 402, PHOTO 410. Sequencing prereqs per map: PHOTO 312 & PHOTO 280 require PHOTO 302 (or equivalent/technical competency upon portfolio evaluation). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
